subtitle: Investor-grade hostile claim audit for SkyeMusicNexus inside the greater 0S.
boardRoomVerdict: SkyeMusicNexus is defensible as a production-mounted, shared-gate, stress-backed music operations cockpit with artist intake, DAW beta, audio upload/stream, releases, rights, drops, in-house FS27 SkyeNet public campaign-page deployment, exchange, social feed, operator actions, payment ledgers, analytics, and observability. It is not defensible as a fully autonomous DSP distributor, R2-scale audio host for private masters/stems, formal legal provider, or real-money payout processor until provider credentials, completed contractor/artist payout packets, owner approval, and payout receipts are attached.

statusLegend.meaning: The claim is backed by production browser proof, API calls, gated routing, and retained records.
The claim survived controlled local/Worker stress and is visible in production evidence, but the wording must stay close to the proven behavior.
The wiring or contract exists, but the outside provider, credential, legal process, or money movement is not proven live.

claims.claim: SkyeMusicNexus owner/admin screens are behind the shared 0S/FS27/SkyGate/Free99 gate, not a separate app password.
claims.skepticQuestion: Can an unauthenticated user reach admin or music APIs, and did the app invent its own admin credential?
proof: Production browser receipt: unauthenticated /SkyeMusicNexus/public/command-dashboard.html and /SkyeMusicNexus/public/admin.html redirected to /admin/login.html with x-0s-gate fs27-required.
Production browser receipt: /api/skymusicnexus/visuals and /api/skymusicnexus/observability returned gated 401 without a session.
Observability API reports auth.sharedZeroOsGate true and auth.appSpecificAdminPassword false.
Worker code routes operator-only music actions through requireOperatorAuth.
claims.boardRoomLanguage: Claim shared-gate owner/admin protection. Do not claim an app-local admin system.

claims.claim: The platform exposes a navigable music operating surface: dashboard, create, DAW, drops, discover, feed, upload, player, releases, rights, exchange, operator, readiness, and command dashboard.
claims.skepticQuestion: Do the screens actually exist and render in production after login on desktop and mobile?
proof: Production browser receipt scanned every Nexus room on desktop and mobile, scrolled the pages, and saved screenshots.
The full route scan passed expected text checks for the app directory, DAW, upload, player, releases, rights, exchange, drops, operator, exports, stems, readiness, and command dashboard.
The command dashboard rendered live visual data from /api/skymusicnexus/visuals.
claims.boardRoomLanguage: Claim a real mounted music operations cockpit with live rooms and walkthrough guidance.

claims.claim: SkyeMusicNexus has a first-party native DAW room with transport, audio import/decode, keys, pads, editing, save, and mixdown/export handoff.
claims.skepticQuestion: Is there a real DAW surface, and is it honestly labeled beta?
proof: PLATFORM_TRUTH.json lists the first-party DAW route and its capabilities.
Local smoke and Playwright E2E in npm run 0s:skyemusicnexus:proof passed.
Production headed browser clicked DAW audio, play, and stop controls.
Production route scan verified the DAW beta banner and quickstart state.
limits: Keep DAW beta visible. Do not sell it as a finished Pro Tools, Ableton, or BandLab replacement.
claims.boardRoomLanguage: Claim native DAW beta and creation handoff, not finished professional DAW parity.

claims.claim: Artists can upload audio, create upload sessions, complete uploads, list assets, and stream audio through gated MusicNexus APIs.
claims.skepticQuestion: Is audio just UI text, or does it hit storage and stream back through the backend?
proof: Production browser matrix called music-assets storage-status, create-upload-session, complete-upload, upload, list, and stream with 200 responses.
Mounted Worker stress retained 12 asset records and proved upload/stream workflows.
Worker production storage-status returns worker-kv, durable true, directUploadAvailable false.
Observability reports storage.mode kv and stateKey skymusicnexus:v1:state.
limits: Production 0S lane proves Worker KV audio proof storage and gated streaming, not R2/CDN large-object audio hosting.
R2/direct browser upload is documented but requires R2 credentials and CORS before that claim can be sold.
claims.boardRoomLanguage: Claim gated upload/session/stream in Worker KV; mark R2-scale object storage as a provider boundary.

claims.claim: Release Forge and Rights Vault store releases, rights attestations, playback-stream events, review, publish, reporting, operations queues, rights audits, workflow timelines, and takedown-style holds.
claims.skepticQuestion: Are rights and release controls wired, or is this only a front-end checklist?
proof: Production browser matrix ran submit, playback-stream, update-rights, review, publish, report-streams, queue-operations, update-operations, list, get, rights-audit, operations-board, and workflow-timeline.
Local stress assertions include release submit, rights update, stream, and observability/audit retention.
PROOF_STATUS.md states playback remains blocked until ownership and preview-use are attested, and distribution actions require the rights gate.
limits: This is product control proof. It is not formal legal advice, a registered DMCA-agent operation, or licensed DSP catalog administration.
claims.boardRoomLanguage: Claim rights-aware product controls and audit trail. Do not claim legal representation or live DSP licensing.

claims.claim: Music drops can be created, updated, submitted, tracked, batched, sent for approval, approved, run through an approval brain, bundled, published through the in-house FS27 SkyeNet deploy lane, held, rejected, and private delivery can be revoked.
claims.skepticQuestion: If the sales story says drops, can the system actually create and move a drop through lifecycle state?
proof: Production browser matrix ran 15 drop actions including create-drop, update-drop, submit-drop, track-public-event, form-batch, send-approval, approve-batch, run-approval-brain, build-static-bundle, publish-batch, hold-drop, revoke-private-delivery, reject-drop, hub/list/get/deploy-pool/batch-preview/traffic-estimate/env-status.
Mounted Worker stress retained 12 drop records.

Worker source now prefers FS27 SkyeNet for publish-batch: it calls /deploy/init, uploads bundle files to the zero-os-deploy-artifacts R2-backed lane through /deploy/upload, completes the manifest, and registers a public /skynet/musicnexus/<batchId> route in FS27 ROUTING_KV.

FS27 SkyeNet deploy/runtime API is already deployed on skyegatefs27-citadeldb with R2 deployment assets, KV routing, Analytics Engine, queue logging, and a smoke-proven /skynet-smoke route recorded in the ultimate handoff.
limits: Claim in-house FS27 SkyeNet public campaign-page deployment after live-browser receipt confirms the routed URL renders.
Private delivery is product-gated state proof, not a full commercial file-delivery CDN claim.
Netlify is no longer the primary MusicNexus drop deploy claim; the observed Netlify API account currently blocks new deploys because credits are exceeded.
claims.boardRoomLanguage: Claim end-to-end drop workflow plus in-house SkyeNet campaign-page deployment when the live routed URL receipt is present. Keep private masters/stems and payout rails separated from public drop pages.

claims.claim: The feed stores local posts, actions, connector metadata, provider queues, feed syncs, and moderation while keeping provider tokens out of browser code.
claims.skepticQuestion: Is social publishing real, and what happens without provider credentials?
proof: Production browser matrix ran save-connector, create-feed-post, like/save/boost/comment actions, queue-post, publish-post, sync-feed, moderate-post, hub, feed, and catalog.
Production browser receipt confirmed provider boundary text: Attach provider token env to publish.
music-social source returns provider-token-required when connector token env is missing.
limits: Provider publication is not live unless the server env token is attached and re-proven.
Native ActivityPub server operations still need federation identity, HTTP signatures, moderation, and abuse controls.
claims.boardRoomLanguage: Claim local feed, queue, moderation, and token-safe connector contract. Do not claim provider-posting is live without provider-token proof.

claims.claim: MusicNexus supports content requests, inbox threads, community posts, release campaign packs, and creator exchange work packets.
claims.skepticQuestion: Can an artist or operator actually request creative work and move campaign tasks?
proof: Production browser matrix ran request-content, send-message, publish-community, build-release-campaign, and exchange hub.
Local stress assertions include exchange, feed, and social queue survival.
The app dashboard exposes the Artist Exchange room and campaign/work request language.
claims.boardRoomLanguage: Claim creator exchange work packets and campaign coordination inside the music ops lane.

claims.claim: MusicNexus can credit artist ledgers, queue payouts, complete payout state, and expose ledger/payout views.
claims.skepticQuestion: If you say artists/contractors can be paid, is cash actually leaving a bank account?
proof: Production browser matrix ran music-payments credit, payout, complete-payout, ledger, and payouts with 200 responses.
Worker source stores payment ledger and payout status in MusicNexus state.

RouteXFlow has stronger provider-call proof for Stripe-compatible payment-state paths, and Marketing Made Easy now holds the encrypted contractor packet/W-9/payout-profile inbox with owner approval and Resend notification.
limits: MusicNexus payout completion is ledger/status proof, not a live bank/Stripe Connect/ACH payout claim.
Use the encrypted contractor packet inbox, SkyeRouteXFlow, and SkyePay receipts when discussing broader workforce/payment rails, and still separate ledger proof from actual money movement.
claims.boardRoomLanguage: Claim payout-ledger readiness and operator payment-state workflow. Automatic real contractor payout release requires completed packet, W-9 upload, encrypted payout profile, owner approval, and provider payout setup.

claims.claim: The platform makes front/back wiring observable through route health, workflow state, KPIs, audit events, storage mode, auth posture, and dashboard visuals.
claims.skepticQuestion: Can a user or operator see that the front end and backend are actually talking?
proof: Production command dashboard loaded live visual data from /api/skymusicnexus/visuals first.
Production browser receipt verified 4 KPIs, 11 route-health cards, 9 flow cards, and 50 audit rows.
Mounted Worker stress retained 192 audit events and verified observability/visuals routes under authenticated read stress.
Visual data kit explicitly labels fallback when live data is unavailable.
claims.boardRoomLanguage: Claim live observable front/back wiring with audit-event retention.

claims.claim: SkyeMusicNexus gives independent artists and operators the keys to run a music enterprise type of business from creation through drops, rights, rollout, exchange, and operator command.
claims.skepticQuestion: Is that claim too big for what is proven?
proof: The full production matrix touched platform, artists, assets, studio, releases, drops, exchange, social, payments, provider-hooks, analytics, visuals, and observability families.
Route scan proved human-facing rooms for each workflow.
Command dashboard makes counts, route health, workflow state, and audit events visible.
limits: Use 'music operations cockpit' or 'enterprise-style operating lane' instead of 'complete autonomous music enterprise' until R2/audio CDN, live provider posting, DSP ingestion, legal review fulfillment, and real payout rails are connected.
The board-room story should connect MusicNexus to the broader 0S, RouteXFlow, SovereignDocs, SkyePay, and LegalSkyes lanes rather than pretending MusicNexus alone does every external job.
claims.boardRoomLanguage: Claim enterprise-style music operations under 0S. Avoid implying every external provider rail is fully live inside MusicNexus alone.

claims.claim: SkyeRouteXFlow provides the workforce command center counterpart for provider jobs, contractor boards, assignments, proof media, payment-state ledgers, exports, integrations, and route/workflow operations.
claims.skepticQuestion: Can the contractor/workforce story be backed outside the music app?
proof: SkyeRouteX live production stress receipt passed desktop, mobile, and FS27 gate dashboard views.

Mounted Worker stress executed market, job, route, application, roster, assignment, contractor progress, route stops, proof media, approval, dispute, freeze, rating, workflow board, exports, manual compliance, storage, integrations, and outbox paths.

Mounted Worker stress recorded 86 provider calls and assertions for Stripe-compatible payment state, Twilio-compatible notifications, Mapbox-compatible route enrichment, R2/S3 proof storage, Certn background invite, and signed webhook lanes.
Contractor packet intake exists in Marketing Made Easy under the same 0S gate and stores W-9/agreement/payout files encrypted before owner approval.
limits: The RouteX proof marks missing provider credentials for background-check webhooks and Stripe live capture proof; keep those as provider-gated unless new live receipts are produced.
claims.boardRoomLanguage: Use RouteXFlow as the workforce and contractor command center counterpart, with encrypted contractor packet intake and provider-gated external payout rails called out.

claims.claim: SovereignDocs supplies the document, vault, legal-review, SkyeDocxMax handoff, and official-workflow side of the broader 0S operating system.
claims.skepticQuestion: Do document workflows actually write, return, store, and stay gated?
proof: Live auth/write proof created a SkyeDocxMax handoff session, fetched it, marked it opened, returned an edited package, and verified the return, document, and vault record persisted.
Final postdeploy proof re-read the return, document, vault record, content run, local brain feed, and no-auth admin connector boundary.
SkyeDocxMax lean live browser report passed mounted desktop and mobile DocxMax routes after the shared 0S gate.
Legal review live proof verified legal review lane pages, partner data, route manifest, protected network API, SkyePay offer, and changelog.
limits: SovereignDocs proves document workflow and legal-review lane routing; it is not a blanket legal-advice claim unless attorney partner fulfillment is separately engaged and proven.
claims.boardRoomLanguage: Claim document/vault/legal-review workflow infrastructure, with attorney/legal-service boundaries explicit.

claims.claim: MusicNexus is a gated counterpart of the larger 0S rather than a loose static preview.
claims.skepticQuestion: Is this mounted into the same production control plane and default-deny auth perimeter?
proof: MusicNexus routes and APIs are mounted on https://metraiyux-0s-full-system.graylondonskyes.workers.dev.
The 0S gate audit in the ledger shows default-deny routing across mounted surfaces.
MusicNexus production receipts show unauthenticated redirects/401s and authenticated shared owner session rendering.
MCP mining was run against the MusicNexus folder before this audit and returned zero failed calls.
claims.boardRoomLanguage: Claim 0S-mounted counterpart with shared auth and production Worker receipts.

doNotClaimYet: Do not claim MusicNexus is a live DSP distributor until DSP provider credentials, ingestion receipts, takedown process, and delivery acknowledgements exist.
Do not claim R2/CDN-scale audio hosting for MusicNexus production until R2 credentials, bucket CORS, object writes, object reads, and browser proof are attached.

Do not claim automatic real-money artist or contractor payouts from MusicNexus until contractor/artist payout packet completion, owner approval, Stripe Connect, ACH, or equivalent provider payout receipts exist.
Do not claim formal legal advice, registered DMCA-agent operations, or attorney review from MusicNexus alone.
Do not claim external social provider posting is live without provider-token proof and provider response receipts.
Do not claim every drop is autonomously published to a public CDN until the deploy provider returns live public URLs.

Rights-aware release/playback controls and takedown-style hold behavior as product controls.
Music payment ledger and payout status workflow, with real-money payout release gated by contractor/artist packet, owner approval, and provider setup.
Greater 0S tie-in through SkyeRouteXFlow workforce command and SovereignDocs document/vault/legal-review workflow receipts.
